name: @activepieces/piece-shippo
description: Multi-carrier shipping platform for real-time rates, labels, and tracking

create_order.name: create_order
create_order.description: Create a new order in Shippo

order_number.description: Custom reference number for the order

placed_at.description: When the order was placed by the buyer (mandatory) - Format: 2025-10-31T11:56:29.244Z

total_price.description: Total price including shipping and tax

line_item_total_price.description: Total price for this line item (quantity × unit price)

weight.description: Total weight of the package for shipping (e.g., "2.5")

shipping_method.description: Shipping method name (e.g., "USPS First Class Package") - optional

additional_line_items.description: Additional line items in JSON format. Example: [{"title": "Product 2", "quantity": 2, "total_price": "20.00"}]

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new order record in Shippo with recipient address, totals, and optional sender address and line items. Use to register an incoming purchase before generating shipments or labels. Requires order number, recipient address, total price, currency, order date, and total package weight; a single line item can be passed via the flat item fields and more via the additional line items JSON array. Not idempotent: each call creates a separate order even with identical input.

find_order.name: find_order
find_order.description: Search for an order by its ID

order_id.description: The ID of the order to find

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves a single Shippo order by its object ID. Use to look up the full details of a known order. Requires the exact order ID; it does not search by order number or other fields. Read-only and idempotent.

find_shipping_label.name: find_shipping_label
find_shipping_label.description: Search for a shipping label by its ID

label_id.description: The ID of the shipping label to find

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves a single Shippo shipping label (transaction) by its object ID, including tracking number and label/document URLs. Use to look up a known label. Requires the exact label ID; it does not search by tracking number or other fields. Read-only and idempotent.

new_shipping_label.name: new_shipping_label
new_shipping_label.description: Trigger when a new shipping label is created

test_mode.description: Include test shipping labels in the trigger

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new shipping label (transaction) is created in the connected Shippo account, polling for labels created since the last check. By default test-mode labels are excluded; enable the option to include them.

new_order.name: new_order
new_order.description: Trigger when a new order is created

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a new order is created in the connected Shippo account, polling for orders placed since the last check (compared by order placed-at time).
